subject: Mythology
title: The Creation Myth of Heliopolis
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Creation Myth of Heliopolis.

hook.text: Before the world existed, there was only an infinite dark ocean called Nun with no land, light, or life.

buildup.text: The god Atum emerged from the waters, standing alone on a tiny mound of earth — the first land ever.

discovery.text: Atum created the first two gods from his own body: Shu, god of air, and Tefnut, goddess of moisture.

twist.text: Each generation created the next. Sky and earth were born, then Osiris, Isis, Set, and Nephthys appeared.

climax.text: Every Egyptian temple was built on a raised platform, symbolizing that first sacred mound of creation.

punchline.text: The whole world began with one god standing on one small hill.

quiz.question: What was Nun in the Egyptian creation myth?
options: The first pharaoh who shaped the world
An infinite dark ocean that existed before creation
A sacred mountain where the gods were born
